comingLast.roast: a high marker holding the blue balls - the honour board salutes the effort
escape requires 9 over the last 6 - his mates have started filming
current run rate 1.2 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
he can still pass Bradley - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
the escape hatch: 5 points in 6 holes - all downhill from here, hopefully not literally
needs 5 points from his last 6 to hand the blue balls to Bradley
4 points from escape - Bradley has stopped watching his own card
2 points to safety - his back nine just became the main event
3 above Bradley from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
in the clubhouse 3 above Bradley - cheering for him from a safe distance
